items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: Did you know Dave DePas? Dave DePas? Yeah, he played with the Young Living Band later on in years, too.

ctx.x: Did you play with any other kids before you had the drums? Well I used to be on the corners. Pick up group or anything?

No, I used to, I was the main attraction. I was always the main attraction. And the guys would have maybe a comb and they'd whistle. And I'd play the drums. At that time I got two sticks from the chairs, from the old chair, and I made the points on them, you know, playing out. What kind of whistle? Oh, just whistle, I mean it's like a whistle. Oh, you know, like a kid whistler. Yeah, just whistle, just whistle. Playing whistle without a whistle or a fife or anything like that. Where did you just play? Play up and…
The other one? Yeah, he played with the Young Living Band, buddy.
